definition: Natural language processing (NLP) is the processing of natural language information by a computer.
details: NLP is a subfield of computer science and is closely associated with artificial intelligence. NLP is also related to information retrieval, knowledge representation, computational linguistics, and linguistics more broadly. Major processing tasks in an NLP system include: speech recognition, text classification, natural language understanding, and natural language generation.

explainer.lead: NLP is the processing of natural language information by a computer, a subfield of computer science closely tied to AI. It matters because it underpins speech recognition, text classification, understanding and generation.

tiers.eli5: It is everything a computer does to work with human language, from listening to writing.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers build pipelines spanning speech recognition, text classification, natural language understanding and generation. A pitfall is treating these tasks as one problem when each has distinct requirements.
tiers.paperLevel: The processing of natural language information by a computer; a subfield of computer science associated with AI and related to information retrieval, knowledge representation and computational linguistics. Major tasks include speech recognition, text classification, natural language understanding and natural language generation.

explainer.example: A voice assistant recognizes speech, classifies the request, and generates a spoken reply, exercising several NLP tasks.
